_conventions: Per-bone rotations in degrees, body frame, right-wing convention, chained shoulder->elbow->wrist. sweep + = tip aft, elev + = tip up, twist + = leading edge up. scale_x compresses the chord (feathers fanning shut). Targets: fits3 photo fits and refs/stoop/poses.md.

soar.target: photo fits A, P02: arm -2..+1 deg, hand -4..+1 deg; b/L ~2.2

glide.target: photo fits B, P03, P04, P06: arm +2 deg fwd, hand 10 deg aft; flight span ~0.85-0.9 of pressed; b/L ~2.0

flap_top.target: top of stroke +36 deg (Mills 2018 amplitude 72 deg; cm181)

flap_mid.target: mid-downstroke: full span, elevation 0, slight pronation

upstroke.target: span 0.5-0.7 of full, wrist leads, hand swept 30-60 deg (Hedenstrom 2009, Tobalske 2011; generic)

upstroke_top.target: late upstroke: arm high, hand still flexed

stoop_tuck.target: width/L 0.26-0.36 (Ponitz 2014 Fig 7 A-B); primaries parallel to body; tips ~0.88 L from bill

pullout_early.target: 5a: span/L 0.76, hands parallel to body, wrists 0.25-0.28 L off midline and ~0.08 L ahead of the shoulder, tips ~0.90 L (Selim 2020 Fig 2a)

stoop_m.target: 5b: span/L 1.2-1.7, hand sweep ~52 deg, arm 10-29 deg forward, tips 0.69-0.78 L; hands droop toward ~60 deg in front view (Selim 2020; cm018, cm070)
